text:
maya: quick sanity check — brought reranker-v2-int8 up to staging. short summary: head NDCG@10 up, MRR@1 down on long queries (>512 tokens). anyone seen this pattern before?
sam: paste the numbers? :thinking:
maya: sure. eval-bot posted results below.
```
CORE_SET (100k): NDCG@10 +2.8%
TAIL_512+ (12k): MRR@1 -4.1%, NDCG@10 +0.3%
SYNTH_NEGS: small noise, p=.04
LATENCY: +6ms 95p (int8)
```
li: interesting — int8 PTQ usually hurts head less and tail more. but here head improves. could be candidate-text formatting differences? did you switch doc concat rules?
maya: i didn't intentionally change formatting. used onboarding config from newmodel-2026 branch — it applies sentence-join for passages.
sam: can you repro offline with prod preproc? maybe the eval harness tokenization differs.
maya: running repro now locally. command: `python eval/run.py --model reranker-v2-int8 --cohort tail_512_plus --preproc prod`
...
ops-bot: job 34912 started on runner-9 (staging).
(maya later) maya: repro done — same drop. ran with identical preproc to prod.
li: ok next: ablate sentence-join. keep same model but swap to old concat.
sam: also check candidate ordering/shuffle seed. weird gains on head could be ordering artifact.
maya: ablation results:
```
old-concat: TAIL_512+ MRR@1 -0.7% (vs baseline)
sentence-join: TAIL_512+ MRR@1 -4.1%
shuffle-seed-42: small variance +/-0.2%
```
maya: so sentence-join seems to amplify the MRR drop.
li: hypothesis: sentence-join compresses useful signals for first-pass scoring so top-1 gets shuffled. also int8 quant noise might amplify weak early logits.
sam: can we try hybrid quant (only feed-forward int8, attention fp16)? previous experiments showed smaller quality regressions.
maya: queued hybrid run now. commands and logs: `./ci/run_quant_sweep --profile hybrid --cohort tail_512_plus`
ops-bot: quant sweep 34913 queued.
eval-bot: hybrid result (quick pass): TAIL_512+ MRR@1 -1.0%, NDCG@10 +0.9%
maya: promising. would like to run longer eval and a few more dataset slices (docs with heavy HTML metadata, title-only, multi-passage).
li: also add tokenizer parity check: different whitespace trimming can move the first token window. run `tools/tokenizer_diff --a prod --b staging --sample 5k`
sam: can you add a tiny human read check for failure cases? like examples where baseline top1 relevant but new model misses.
maya: doing that now — will drop 50 failures in the thread when ready.
(maya later) maya: quick note — found two cases where sentence-join introduced repeated sentence prefixes which pushed relevant passage down. attaching one snippet: `doc: \"How to reset API key. Steps: 1) Go to... 2) Click reset...\"` turned into `\"How to reset API key. How to reset API key. Steps:...\"` after join.
sam: aha — dedupe step needed in concat. can we sanitize join to collapse repeats?
li: we should also add a regression gate for tail-MRR in onboarding pipeline. maybe require tail MRR delta > -2% to pass for int8.
maya: +1. I'll add an eval stage in the bringup job.
eval-bot: regression gate suggestion created: pipeline/bringup/reranker-v2-int8 -> add check tail_mrr > baseline - 0.02
sam: thanks. plan: 1) fix sentence-join dedupe 2) rerun hybrid quant + int8 after fix 3) add gate. timeline?
maya: aiming EOD today for quick fix + hybrid retest, longer sweep tomorrow.
li: ping me if you need extra GPU for sweep.
maya: thanks — will update thread with failure samples. :thumbsup:
